 Versus

Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Tapan Singh, learned Counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. This Contempt Petition preferred under Section 
12 of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 is directed for 
willful disobedience and non-compliance of order 
dated 06.06.2024 (Annexure No.1) passed by this 
Court in Appeal from Order No.119 of 2024 (Smt. 
Rekha v. Ashish Luthara) whereby the appeal was 
dismissed in terms of the settlement arrived at 
between the parties, as discussed in paragraph no.6 of 
the said judgment; thereby, it was directed that 
husband Ashish Luthara shall deposit a sum of 
rupees ten lakh towards permanent alimony to the 
appellant-wife Smt. Rekha Rani in her account 
maintained in Punjab and Sind Bank, Branch 
Gurudwara Road, Saharanpur (U.P.) being A/c
No.06081000015794 of Smt. Rekha Rani having IFSC 
Code PSIB0000608 through RTGS within three weeks 
from the date of judgment. The wife-Smt. Rekha, in 
turn, was directed to withdraw all cases filed against 
respondent-husband in various civil and criminal 
courts.  3. It is contended by learned Counsel for petitioner 
that the said judgment and order dated 06.06.2024 
was challenged by respondent-wife in SLP(C) No.447 
of 2025 (Rekha v. Ashish Luthara) which, after 
attempt of mediation between the parties, was finally 
dismissed by Hon’ble Supreme Court on 27.02.2026. 
The order of the Apex Court is annexed as Annexure 
No.3 to the contempt petition. 
4. It is contended by learned Counsel for petitioner 
that the petitioner has deposited the amount of 
Rs.10.00 lakh through RTGS in the account, 
mentioned hereinabove on 20.06.2024, but despite 
the deposit having been made by petitioner, till date, 
civil/criminal cases pending against the petitioner￾husband, details whereof given in paragraph no.7 of 
the contempt petition, have yet not been withdrawn.
5. Learned Counsel for petitioner further submits 
that this is a gross violation of this Court’s order dated 
06.06.2024.
6. Issue notice to the respondent-contemnor 
returnable within six weeks.
7. Steps be taken within three days through all 
permissible modes as per rules.
8. List on 15.09.2026, by which time, the 
respondent-contemnor shall comply with the order, or 
to file her response.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 20.07.2026 R.Dang
